title: Réflexions sur la violence
shelf_note: Sorel, 2nd edition (Paris, Marcel Rivière), as catalogued.
rights_flag: A 1910 French edition; Sorel died in 1922, so it is public domain in most jurisdictions. No modern copyright page seen.
structure_note: 6 pages lack OCR (422/428). Page 10's stored text describes a blank stamped leaf while the image is the printed wrapper or title, so the text belongs to a neighbouring leaf. Check its neighbours for a one-leaf shift.

book_verdict: Wrong leaf: the printed title page is served with another leaf's 'blank, embossed stamp' description, so the title text is missing. Check neighbouring pages for a shift.
